critical_code_review_comments: Mobile .prose h2 at 390px width resolves to 20.8px (1.3rem) because the <=420px media rule overrides the 840px rule. This satisfies the stated <=25px requirement but is ~32% smaller than desktop (30.4px), not the 20-25% target in the spec. If the ~23.2px (1.45rem) look was intended at 390px, raise the <=420px breakpoint value or lower the breakpoint to <=360px. Not a defect, flagging intent mismatch only.
